content:
In Southeast Asia a convert to Islam is often met with suspicion from two sides. Some say the convert changed religion to marry, and others say the convert gave up an ethnic identity along with an old faith. Both charges are made of public figures in Indonesia, and the record of their own words answers them.

The region's converts are called muallaf in Malay and Indonesian, from the Quran's word for those whose hearts are brought together. Their stories are usually told at the moment of conversion and rarely afterwards, when family, food and identity have to be worked out.

This article aims to provide context to those charges, insha'Allah, in four Indonesian conversions whose facts are on record, each read for the question it answers. The Quran sets the frame for all of them: "Let there be no compulsion in religion: Truth stands out clear from Error" (2:256).[1]

Iga Mawarni, a jazz singer well known in the 1990s, embraced Islam on 23 March 1994 in Malang, East Java. iNews described her path as "pencarian keimanan yang begitu panjang", a very long search for faith.[2]

The Quran describes the end of such a search in its own words: "for without doubt in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find satisfaction" (13:28).[1]

When the television presenter Deddy Corbuzier embraced Islam in June 2019, the press asked whether he had done it to marry. His answer to ANTARA: "Saya masuk Islam tidak ada yang menyuruh, tidak karena satu tujuan, banyak yang tanya apa karena mau nikah? Enggak, saya pindah karena hidayah": "Nobody told me to become Muslim, and not for one purpose. Many ask if it is because I want to marry. No, I changed because of guidance."[3]

He had studied for "hampir setahun, sudah delapan bulan lebih", almost a year, more than eight months, with Gus Miftah at the Ora Aji pesantren in Sleman. His teacher said he never once urged him to convert.[3] The account is the Quran's rule in practice: guidance is God's to give (28:56), and the teacher's part is to answer questions.

Felix Siauw is a Chinese Indonesian preacher with a large following on social media. In his own telling, he went from a Chinese Catholic to a Muslim after learning about Islam from friends in 2002, as a student at the Bogor Agricultural Institute (IPB).[4]

His story answers the claim that Islam belongs to one ethnic group. The Quran addresses all peoples together: "O mankind! We created you from a single (pair) of a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes, that ye may know each other" (49:13).[1] Hew Wai Weng, who has studied him, titled his book on Chinese Muslims in Indonesia for exactly this: Chinese Ways of Being Muslim.[5]

Siauw is also known for his ties to Hizbut Tahrir Indonesia, a group the government has since banned.[4] His conversion is told here as a conversion; it is no endorsement of his politics.

The actor Roger Danuarta embraced Islam on 29 October 2018. Before he did, he asked his family: "gue tanya juga sama nyokap, sama saudara-saudara", "I asked my mother and my brothers and sisters too."[6]

His mother set one condition: "kalau benar memang pengin pindah (agama) jalaninya yang benar", if you really want to change religion, do it properly. She told him to learn to read the Quran and to pray.[6] The preacher who guided him, Insan Mokoginta, said he had long studied Islam with Muslim friends and had his mother's permission.[7]

The Quran asks the same respect of a convert towards the parents he leaves in another faith: "bear them company in this life with justice (and consideration)" (31:15).[1]

The bottom line

Four Indonesians came to Islam by four roads: a long search, months of study with a patient teacher, a student's friendships, and a family's blessing with a condition attached. In each case the record of their own words answers the charge that they converted only for marriage or under pressure, or that faith required them to stop being who they were.

The stories show the Quran's terms at work. Nobody can be compelled, a teacher can only invite, and parents of another faith are still owed kindness. "Invite (all) to the Way of thy Lord with wisdom and beautiful preaching" (16:125).[1] Allahu alam.

Notes

  1. Quran 2:256; 13:28; 16:125; 28:56; 31:14 to 15; 49:13, translated by A. Yusuf Ali.
  2. Muhammad Sukardi, "Kisah Iga Mawarni Penyanyi Jazz Cantik Era 1990-an Menjadi Mualaf", iNews, 24 August 2021.
  3. Ida Nurcahyani, "Deddy Corbuzier masuk Islam karena mendapat hidayah", ANTARA, 21 June 2019.
  4. "Social Media and Islamic Propagation to Muslim Youth in Indonesia", Wednesday Forum report, Center for Religious and Cross-cultural Studies, Universitas Gadjah Mada, 20 September 2017, reporting a talk by Hew Wai Weng.
  5. Hew Wai Weng, Chinese Ways of Being Muslim (Copenhagen: NIAS Press, 2017).
  6. Ferry Noviandi and Evi Ariska, "Izin Pindah Agama, Roger Danuarta Diomeli Ibu Habis-habisan", Suara.com, 24 February 2021.
  7. Revi C. Rantung, "Ustadz Insan Mokoginta Jelaskan Alasan Roger Danuarta Jadi Mualaf", Okezone, 31 October 2018.
